The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
image->is_finished;
```
Reason:
The `is_finished` member of the `image` structure is used without being initialized, which can lead to a conditional jump based on uninitialized data. This can cause unpredictable behavior or crashes when the program attempts to evaluate the state of `is_finished`.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
image->is_finished = false;
```
Reason:
This line initializes the `is_finished` member of the `image` structure to `false`, ensuring that it has a defined value before being used in any conditional checks. This prevents the conditional jump on uninitialized data, thereby stabilizing the program's behavior.
